messages:
Noah: quick sync: we need a tiny, versioned admit handshake for ingest -> registry -> router. goal: deterministic routing and safe canaries.
Zara: minimal fields only: model_id, version, fingerprint, variant, admit_state. keep bench metadata out of hot path.
Miko: propose admit_state values: pending, canary, approved, rejected. router uses "canary" to apply percent-based routing.
Ethan: bench SLA: enqueue and aim to finish within 12h. if bench exceeds 24h mark admit_state=stale and signal owner.
Noah: runtime probes: 3 quick checks (shape smoke, kv roundtrip, golden-checksum). must be under 300ms total. failures -> runtime circuit-break.
Zara: registry storage: use etcd with small admit records; router caches with 3s TTL and subscribes to updates.
Miko: legacy migration: backfill fingerprints async. mark legacy=true during backfill so router treats them as conservative.
Ethan: policy: teams can opt into "allow_partial=true" for internal models via Console. default strict for customer-facing models.
RegistryBot: admit-write API available: PUT /admit/{model_id}/{ver} returns 200; watch stream at /watch/admit.
Noah: ok action items: Zara drafts admit JSON schema; Miko writes probe spec; Ethan drafts bench SLA alerting; I'll open tickets to wire router caching. target: next sync. :thumbsup:
